main_text.head: RESPICE FINEM ET NON peccabis.
main_text.p: [Woodcut emblem: a skeleton beneath a winged globe with a figure, a crowned chest above the clouds, trumpets, and a landscape below; not transcribed as text.]
main_text.l: Pectore vt intrepidus læto vltima fata capessas,
In Domino fidens spiçula Mortis aret.

page.notes: The verse is set in italic type and is copied as printed, including the long s written as f in "fata" and "firmet" where the printer used it; "spiçula" is printed as such. The word "VINCV" at lower right is set in small capitals with a stroke over the final letter; it is copied as VINCV. The page number 256 is printed with a superscript-like mark at the top left and may be partly damaged. The emblem is a woodcut and is not transcribed.
